name: dsh-git-graph-sidebar
description: Git commit graph chip plus a better-sidebar repository tab (SVG lane canvas, zoom, pinned commit card) that discovers the Git repositories up to three levels below the workspace directory and bootstraps a Git conventions document for each one and checks commit compliance against it; a conventions document is inherited by the repositories nested in it, conflicting and duplicated documents are reported to the agent, which reads them in full with its own file tools and writes the merged document itself, following the backup and inheritance-pointer rules the injected prompt carries - the plugin registers no tool of its own and ships no merger. Prose documents that state commit rules (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, CONTRIBUTING.md) next to the workspace or the repository are read with the same rule reader, so rules living outside the conventions document still reach the conflict report; those files are never rewritten. The same tab can also open as an opt-in, closable page in the conversation's main area, beside the shipped views.
author: Athosoo

scripts.test: node scripts/build-lib.mjs && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/index.js && node scripts/validate-lib.mjs && node scripts/test-host.mjs
